option.name: --cd
tip: Set the specified directory as the current working directory
If using ~, it will use the Linux user's home path
If the path starts with a / character, it will be interpreted as an absolute Linux path
Otherwise, the value must be an absolute Windows path

option.name: --debug-shell
tip: Open a WSL2 debug shell for diagnostics

option.name: --distribution
tip: Run the specified distribution

option.name: --distribution-id
tip: Run the specified distribution by ID

option.name: --event-viewer
tip: Open the Application view of Windows Event Viewer

option.name: --exec
tip: Execute the specified command without using the default Linux shell

option.name: --export
tip: Export the distribution as a tar file; for standard output, the filename can be "-"

option.name: --format
tip: Specify the export format: tar, tar.gz, tar.xz, vhd

option.name: --vhd
tip: Specify exporting the distribution as a .vhdx file

option.name: --import
tip: Import the specified tar as a new distribution; for standard input, the filename can be "-"

option.name: --version
tip: Specify the version to use for the new distribution

option.name: --vhd
tip: Specify the provided file as a .vhdx file instead of a tar file
This operation will create a copy of the .vhdx file at the specified installation location

option.name: --import-in-place
tip: Import the specified .vhdx as a new distribution.
This virtual hard disk must be formatted with the ext4 file system type

option.name: --install
tip: Install Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) distributions for Linux
To view the list of available distributions, use wsl --list --online

option.name: --enable-wsl1
tip: Install the distribution using WSL 1

option.name: --fixed-vhd
tip: Install with a fixed size VHD instead of dynamically expanding

option.name: --from-file
tip: Install the distribution from a local file

option.name: --legacy
tip: Install the legacy distribution

option.name: --location
tip: Set the install location for the distribution

option.name: --name
tip: Set the name for the distribution

option.name: --no-distribution
tip: Install without a distribution, only install the optional components

option.name: --no-launch
tip: Install the distribution without launching it afterward

option.name: --version
tip: Specify the version to use for the new distribution

option.name: --vhd-size
tip: Set the virtual hard disk size for the new distribution

option.name: --web-download
tip: Download the distribution from the Internet instead of the Microsoft Store

option.name: --list
tip: List distributions

next.name: --all
tip: List all distributions
Including those currently being installed or uninstalled

next.name: --online
tip: Show a list of available distributions that can be installed

next.name: --quiet
tip: Show only distribution names

next.name: --running
tip: List only currently running distributions

next.name: --verbose
tip: Show detailed information for all distributions

option.name: --manage
tip: Manage distribution settings

option.name: --move
tip: Move the distribution to a new location

option.name: --resize
tip: Resize the distribution's virtual hard disk

option.name: --set-default-user
tip: Set the default user for the distribution

option.name: --set-sparse
tip: Set the distribution's vhdx to be sparse or not

option.name: --mount
tip: Attach and mount physical or virtual disks in all WSL 2 distributions

option.name: --bare
tip: Attach the disk to WSL2 without mounting it

option.name: --name
tip: Use a custom name for the mount point

option.name: --options
tip: Pass mount options

option.name: --partition
tip: Partition index to mount, defaults to the entire disk if not specified

option.name: --type
tip: File system to use when mounting the disk, defaults to ext4 if not specified

option.name: --vhd
tip: Specify that <Disk> represents a virtual hard disk

option.name: --release-notes
tip: Open a web browser to view the WSL release notes page

option.name: --set-default
tip: Set a distribution as the default

option.name: --set-default-version
tip: Change the default installation version for new distributions

option.name: --set-version
tip: Change the version of the specified distribution

option.name: --shell-type
tip: Execute the specified command using the provided shell type

example.desc: Execute the specified command using the default Linux shell

next.name: login
tip: Execute the specified command using the default Linux shell as a login shell

next.name: none
tip: Execute the specified command without using the default Linux shell

next.name: standard
tip: Execute the specified command using the default Linux shell

option.name: --shutdown
tip: Immediately terminate all running distributions and WSL 2 lightweight virtual machines

next.name: --force
tip: Force shutdown even if there are active sessions

option.name: --status
tip: Display the status of Windows Subsystem for Linux
Examples: default distribution type, default distribution, and kernel version, etc.

option.name: --system
tip: Start a shell for the system distribution

option.name: --terminate
tip: Terminate the specified distribution

option.name: --uninstall
tip: Uninstall Windows Subsystem for Linux from Windows

option.name: --unmount
tip: Unmount and detach a disk from all WSL2 distributions
If called without parameters, unmount and detach all disks

option.name: --unregister
tip: Unregister the distribution and delete the root file system

option.name: --update
tip: Update Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) packages

tip: Download pre-release versions if available (implies --web-download)

tip: Download updates from the Internet instead of the Microsoft Store
